extracted.name: Enoki Mushrooms
extracted.description: Enoki mushrooms are long, skinny Japanese mushrooms used in this quick and easy vegan side dish made with sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and soy sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon low-sodium soy sauce (such as Bragg®)
instruction_lines: Cut the bottom 2 inches off enoki mushrooms and discard. Separate mushroom strands gently.

Heat oil in a medium-sized nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until just fragrant, about 1 minute. Add mushrooms; cook and stir until they begin to wilt, about 2 minutes. Add soy sauce and ginger; toss to coat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
